summary: On paper Chicago has the edge (Chicago's defense ranks 22nd in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.09 allowed), while Philadelphia's best counter is to move people pre-snap (Philadelphia ranks 7th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.11). The model favors Chicago at 56%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and rushing matchup (1.6 pts).

PHI.detail: Philadelphia ranks 7th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.11). Chicago's defense ranks 22nd (+0.09 allowed).

CHI.detail: Chicago's defense ranks 22nd in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.09 allowed). Philadelphia ranks 7th (+0.11).

team_cards.t2: Chicago has the 5th-worst defense vs motion.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · PHI: n=39 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Chicago 56% to win, fair line CHI -1.5. Market: Philadelphia 64%. The largest factor is starting qb, worth 1.8 points toward Philadelphia.

model_cards.t1: The model likes Chicago more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Chicago. Sum = CHI -1.5.

model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup
